deck_title: Sutherland-Hodgman homogeneous near-plane clipping vs naive unclipped perspective divide explosion rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Ivan Sutherland & Gary W. Hodgman (CACM 1974) and Jim Blinn & Martin Newell (SIGGRAPH 1978) homogeneous clip-space near-plane segment clipping (t_clip = (w_0 - w_near) / (w_0 - w_1) evaluated BEFORE perspective divide X / w, locking the near-plane screen-space endpoint at x_NDC = 1.0000x across all 17 intrusion stations) versus naive pre-clip perspective divide (dividing X_1 / w_1 directly when w_1 = 1/(1+4u) intrudes inside w_near = 1.0, exploding x_NDC to 2.0000x at u=0.25, 3.0000x at u=0.50, and 5.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-step homogeneous plane bisection.
